description: Second occurrence this session of out-of-band state driving a wrong Q4 rock draft. David corrected three things Quinn's draft had wrong: (1) CBRE/Confluent is NOT a Q4 play; the active co-sell motions with partner Solace are AT&T, McKesson, and SLB, with Austin Ledesma as the seller on Solace's side. (2) A major new Q4 effort existed nowhere in IES: David is working with Curtis (Hite, CEO) to build the plan for David to lead the AI Practice at Improving, to be defined for 2027. (3) Publishing is not stalled: Alice has been publishing to LinkedIn and the blog, and metrics show it is moving very well — the '15 drafts pending, unstuck by Oct 24' premise was wrong (the stall verdict was stale for the same reason as the plays verdict: the work happens outside IES-visible sources).
correction: Rock 1's play set is the One Texas named accounts with Solace co-sell motions (AT&T, McKesson, SLB), not CBRE/Confluent. A new Q4 rock covers defining the AI Practice leadership plan for 2027 with Curtis. Rock 4's publishing premise is corrected: publishing runs via Alice and is performing well.
systemic_fix: Reinforces err-20261009T233929-E4CJTE's proposed fix (ask David directly about out-of-band state before declaring a workstream stalled or unstarted). Second occurrence of the same category + failure_mode this session — one more makes it threshold-alertable.
